description: The dated changes to the lists of several companies at once, each carrying the two readings it came from. The same facts as `changes`, gathered for one reader's own list of companies. Needs a key on an account whose watch is running: this is part of the watch on disclosedby.com. Free to read, cite and link. Every row is a dated quote of a company's own published page: cite the page and the read date. The compilation is protected: extraction or re-use of a substantial part is not permitted, and it may never be compiled into a lead list, a prospecting feed or a sales tool. A key is one reader's own use.

since.description: Optional ISO date; only changes on or after it.
